case.summary: Monitoring sweep on card C09623-K2 over a $549.96 in person transaction on 2016-11-06 found that 3 of the card-detail match flags M1-M9 came back F and step-up authentication was not completed. Against this, $549.96 is 8.0x this card's median and above its 95th percentile, and the card sits in a bounded component of 2 cards (C00266-K1) linked transitively through device profiles each used by no more than 8 cards. The case was assessed as account takeover at probability 0.76 with $570.05 of exposure, 2 transaction(s), and 1 other card(s) transacted through the same device profile in the window and are named for monitoring under policy rule R6.

sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-06 and 2016-11-06, card C09623-K2 belonging to customer C09623 was used for 2 transaction(s) totalling $570.05, of which the transaction that triggered this investigation was $549.96 on 2016-11-06. The activity was conducted in person under product code W, billed in region 204.0. 3 of the card-detail match flags M1-M9 came back F on this transaction, and step-up authentication was not completed. Connected components over the device-sharing graph placed this card in a bounded component of 2 cards (C00266-K1), linked transitively through device profiles each used by no more than 8 cards, indicating a common actor operating across more than one cardholder. On contact, no reply within 24 hours, which is an assumption recorded in the case file because no cardholder replies were available to this investigation. The activity is suspicious because it is consistent with known Account takeover mixed-channel activity inconsistent with the cardholder, pointing to stolen credentials rather than a stolen number, and it was assessed at a 76% probability of being fraudulent based on 3 independent pieces of evidence drawn from the transaction graph and the institution's closed-case history. The filing is made because the activity connects to a device profile shared with other compromised cards, which requires a report regardless of amount, and the closed cases whose transaction most resembles this one (CC-1342, CC-4201, CC-5496, CC-4781, CC-1596) all closed as confirmed fraud. The total amount of suspicious activity is $570.05.
